name: Elsa Adlung
original_name: エルザ・アードルング
source:
A daughter of the nobility from the Reitz Empire, one of the nations that make up the United Kingdom of Limvon.
She pilots the precision-type Walking Tank Schwert, modelled after Western knights.

Proud and high-handed, she possesses absolute confidence in both her combat ability and her command skills.
The armour she wears (a so-called bikini armour) is a venerable heirloom passed down through her family.
Despite its revealing appearance, it offers excellent impact resistance, and she wears it in a wide variety of situations.
…Though, deep down, she apparently finds the outfit just a little embarrassing.

“I suppose… I could acknowledge your worth, but only a little, if you insist!”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#eruza]official website[/url]]
